name: Toradora! Portable
original_name: とらドラ・ポータブル！
source:
You play as Takasu Ryuuji in an alternate memory loss story with many different endings than the original.

The game also features a minigame where Taiga is the playable character fending off lovesick guys.
translation:
玩家扮演高须龙儿，体验一条与原作不同、以失忆为开端并通向多种结局的故事线。

游戏还收录了一款迷你游戏，玩家可操作逢坂大河，击退那些为爱痴狂的男人。
